decisions.reason: Encrypted secondary channel is a low-cost software option aligning with core secure communication and future digital ecosystems.
Multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is foundational for the firm's strategic direction and inexpensive to maintain as a software platform.
QR-code hardware token has higher keeping costs and limited fit with the mobile-first identity strategy, so its option value no longer justifies retention.
Payment security compliance suite leverages existing security infrastructure and serves strong regulatory demand, so keeping the option is justified.
